# ECN-2026-019 - Change notice - Ring Rolling shot blast cabinet #1

Revision: Rev D  
Plant: P3, line P3-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L2-SB01

Reason for change
- Field feedback and inspection records indicate accelerated wear of shot media and variable blast performance from EQ-P3-L2-SB01 during continuous operation. To stabilize surface finish consistency for ring rolling parts and reduce rework, the scheduled shot media top-up interval is revised.
- This change aligns maintenance and operator actions with observed media consumption and reduces the likelihood of nonconforming surface preparation prior to rolling.

Affected items
- EQ-P3-L2-SB01 operating procedure and maintenance checkpoints.
- Operator shift responsibilities for Ring Rolling pre-blast staging.
- Quality hold points for incoming ring blanks that rely on shot blast processing.

Implementation
- Update SOP-P3-L2-02, SOP-P3-L2-03, and SOP-P3-L2-05 to reflect the new media management requirement for EQ-P3-L2-SB01.
- The shot media top-up interval for Ring Rolling shot blast cabinet #1 (EQ-P3-L2-SB01) is 40 hours.
- Maintenance will add a visible top-up checklist to the cabinet door and log entries in the equipment logbook at each top-up event.
- Operators will verify media level and record completion before starting each blast cycle that follows a top-up checklist entry.
- Quality will perform a first-article surface inspection on the next production lot after implementation to confirm finish consistency; any deviations will trigger immediate rollback and corrective action.
- Training: a brief update to affected operators and maintenance personnel will be delivered on the shop floor covering the revised interval and log requirements. Training attendance will be recorded per SOP-P3-L2-05.

Approvals
- Engineering: approval required to revise the listed SOPs and to authorize the implementation steps.
- Maintenance: approval to implement the new checklist and log procedure on EQ-P3-L2-SB01.
- Operations: approval acknowledging the revised operator responsibilities and training requirements.

Related documents: SOP-P3-L2-02, SOP-P3-L2-03, SOP-P3-L2-05
